== Summary ==
The twelve players of the Bespin 2017 Kick Off tournament, October 2016, posted by organizer [[Mark Walseth]] ("12 Good-Fun-People"). The post lists them by name, but the photograph does not mark who is who.

* '''Event:''' [[Bespin 2017 Kick Off]]

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1070258#p1070258 post 1070258] in topic 63255 (Bespin 2017 Kick Off), by Walsetmd, 2016-10-30. Forum attachment id 5055.jpg (2016 Kickoff.JPG). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122223043/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/p1070258.html Internet Archive]
* '''Posted by:''' Walsetmd
